serviceParameters.label: 1. Common - Databricks Workspace Profile
serviceParameters.description: Profile name in the server's .databrickscfg. Enter - for DEFAULT.

serviceParameters.label: 2. Common - Geometry Column
serviceParameters.description: Column holding the geometry, e.g. geom. Required.

serviceParameters.label: 3. Common - ID Field
serviceParameters.description: Unique integer column, e.g. objectid. Esri max 2147483647; larger at your own risk.

serviceParameters.label: 4. Common - Spatial Reference ID / SRID (default 4326)
serviceParameters.description: EPSG code, e.g. 4326. Enter - for the default.

serviceParameters.label: 5. Common - Max Record Count (default 2000)
serviceParameters.description: Rows per page. Enter - for the default.

serviceParameters.label: 8. Lakehouse - Geometry Format
serviceParameters.description: WKT, WKB, GEOJSON or GEOMETRY. Enter - to auto-detect.

serviceParameters.label: 9. Lakehouse - Time Column
serviceParameters.description: Strongly recommended for data over time. Enter - if none (or Lakebase).

serviceParameters.label: 11. Lakebase - Port (default 5432)
serviceParameters.description: Enter - for the default (also for Lakehouse).

serviceParameters.label: 13. Lakebase - Schema (default public)
serviceParameters.description: Enter - for the default (also for Lakehouse).

serviceParameters.label: 15. Lakebase - Enable Editing
serviceParameters.description: true to allow edits. Enter - for read-only (or Lakehouse).

serviceParameters.label: 16. Common - Minimum Scale
serviceParameters.description: Hide when zoomed out past a scale (577791) or zoom 10. Enter - for none.
